facts.value: The Department of Economics offers a joint European Triple-Bachelor in Economics and Business (EU Tribe) in collaboration with partner universities Solvay Brussels School of Economics & Management and LUISS Rome.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Study in three major European cities, at three prestigious universities and receive degrees from the three participating universities, which is the unique educational experience of this Bachelor's program.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The European Triple-Bachelor in Economics and Business (EU Tribe) is structured over three years.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Students of Goethe University spend the first year in Frankfurt, followed by a one-year study period in Brussels and another in Rome.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The studies in Brussels and Rome can be completed entirely in English.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: There is an opportunity to acquire Italian and French language skills or to improve existing language skills.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Participation is only possible for students who start their studies in the winter semester at the Department.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Interested students first apply for the Bachelor's program in Economics at Goethe University. Application for the Triple-Bachelor program occurs in the first semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The abroad phase begins in the third semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: A requirement for admission to the Triple-Bachelor program is good to very good school performance and English skills at B2 level.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The program is supported by scholarships under the Erasmus+ program for a maximum of one academic year (260 days).
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Studying at both partner universities tuition fees are waived for participating students.
